x: Every component in PadCode is a real SwiftUI view: a Text is SwiftUI's Text , a Column is a VStack , a Switch is a Toggle . PadCode draws them from your app's data, without compiling any code. The values that change go in formulas : short expressions, written much like Swift, that PadCode works out as your app runs. If you know Swift, you can read formulas already. This page is what's the same, what isn't, and the function to use for each Swift method you'd reach for. For everything formulas can do, see the formula language reference and every function . # A formula is one expression A formula is a single expression, like the right-hand side of a Swift let : total * (1 + tip) / people .
